name: Ani Nazare
bio: Ani Nazare is a General Partner at FerSil VC based in Berlin. He brings operating and investing experience across enterprise software, telecom, semiconductors, medical devices, and robotics. FerSil leans on Ani where the physical world meets software: industrial automation, edge intelligence, sensing, semis, and systems that learn from real-world deployment rather than only from synthetic data. He has worked across the US, Europe, and India and supports founders on product strategy, scaling, and cross-border growth.

name: Pasha Bogdanov
bio: Pasha Bogdanov is a General Partner at FerSil VC in Berlin. He works across fundraising, LP relations, investments, portfolio support, and fund operations. His investing lens centers on technical founders turning deep engineering into durable businesses, especially where software interfaces with industry, machines, and the built world. He has backed companies across infrastructure software, applied AI, developer tooling, and globally ambitious teams emerging from Central and Eastern Europe.

name: Michael Bastholt
bio: Michael Bastholt is Partner and COO at FerSil VC. He leads firm operations, investor relations, and the operating backbone required to support a concentrated early-stage platform. Michael has spent much of his career on the LP side of venture and private equity, giving FerSil a disciplined perspective on portfolio construction, fund governance, and how emerging managers earn long-term trust. He works closely with founders and LPs as FerSil builds a durable bridge between technical talent and global capital.

name: Russell Green
bio: Russell Green leads finance and reporting at FerSil VC. He oversees fund administration, reporting quality, and the operational cadence behind portfolio and LP communications. Russell's background across venture, private equity, and fund administration adds rigor to the platform, helping FerSil stay detail-oriented while moving fast. He is a key part of keeping the firm institutional where it matters and lightweight where founders need speed.

name: Charlie Ryan
bio: Charlie Ryan serves as LPAC Chairman for FerSil VC. His background spans investment banking, asset management, and governance across global markets. Charlie brings experienced oversight on fund structure, later-stage company development, and strategic outcomes, giving the platform a strong governance counterpart as it backs technical founders building in the real economy.

name: Daniil Stolyarov
bio:
Daniil Stolyarov is a Partner at Almaz Capital based in Silicon Valley.

Working with portfolio executives and entrepreneurs both in Central and Eastern Europe and the US, Daniil is focused on helping companies develop and successfully grow their operations and organizations across borders. Daniil led the Almaz investment in MakeTime and its acquisition by Xometry and serves on the boards of Mobalytics, Petcube and Dmarket.

He is a seasoned investment professional with over 15 years of experience of working with technology, media and communication companies in the fields of corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, strategic partnerships, public and private financings.

Previously Daniil worked at Cowen and Company, Lehman Brothers, and Renaissance Capital.

Prior to his work in banking, Daniil co-founded and served as a board member of itour.ru, an online travel company.

He graduated from Finance Academy in Moscow and earned an MBA from Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth University. Today my interests are in marketplaces in new verticals, blending of physical and digital, E-sports, operating systems and analytics for buildings, manufacturing technologies.

name: Deniz Isil Sahin
bio:
Deniz Isil Sahin is an Analyst at Almaz Capital, based in Berlin, Germany. Deniz is responsible for deal sourcing, analysis, and due diligence. She is focusing on formulating and presenting investment cases to the investment committee alongside Partners.

Prior to Almaz, she worked as an Industrial Engineer at Continental Tire in the United States. In this role, she led corporate projects concerning Production Efficiency and Continues Improvement and achieved major cost savings for the company. She was also responsible for investment planning, capacity planning, and benchmarking activities for the Mixing production department she specialized in. In addition, she took part in corporate data analytics & visualization projects.

Prior to Continental, she worked as a graduate teaching and research assistant at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville. Her independent research on Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems was published in the IISE 2017 Conference Proceedings. She wrote her master’s thesis on Time-Optimal Scheduling of High Throughput System for Drug-Discovery and Virus-Detection.

Deniz holds a M.Sc. degree from Southern Illinois University Edwardsville (SIUE) and a B.Sc. degree from both Istanbul Technical University (ITU) and SIUE as a double-degree. Today my interests are in Business Process Optimization and leading technologies focusing on Automation, Data Analytics, and Machine Learning.

name: Geoffrey Baehr
bio:
Geoffrey Baehr is a General Partner at Almaz Capital investing in areas ranging from security and networking to analytics and big data technologies.

Being a top-level technological expert Geoffrey evaluates technical merit of startups and plays a role of in-house CTO.

He is currently working on edge virtualization and computing, RISC-V-based SoCs for ML/AI, software defined platforms and networks. He is also working on the scaling, management and control of virtualized infrastructure.

Geoffrey is on a panel of reviewers for computer science related proposals and is a member of the IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) and ACM (Association for Computing Machinery).

Previously he was a General Partner and later Venture Partner at US Venture Partners in Silicon Valley. He remains an Advisor to USVP.

Geoffrey served from 1988-2000 as Chief Network Officer for Sun Microsystems responsible for technical and strategic network directions. During his tenure at Sun, he developed advanced technical products and, with his team, obtained more than one dozen patents.

He earned a BA in Biochemistry and Natural Sciences from Fordham University.

name: Vlada Bobrova
bio:
Vlada Bobrova is a Business Assistant at Almaz Capital. Vlada runs administrative functions and coordinates business activities in CEE. Mostly supporting General Partners, she also liaises with the investment team providing full logistics and administrative support all over the world.

She has more than 20 years of professional experience in administrative work and office management. Previously, she worked for the international oil and gas drilling Contractor KCA DEUTAG supporting top management of the company, running business development and company public relations activities. She also was involved in full cycle of tender process documentation on e-trading platforms. Prior to this, she worked in Loyds' Investment CIS Corporation representative sale office of Cessna, Gulfstream and Embraer business jets providing full logistics, interpreting and administrative support to the owner.

During different years she set up and managed her own companies in Thailand property and architectural bureau as a family business.

She graduated from the Moscow State Linguistic University (former Institute of Foreign Languages named after Maurice Thorez) with BA in Linguistics with English and Spanish languages. Today my interests are in  contribute to and create business and logistics processes with perfection and maximum professionalism.

name: Yoav Samet
bio:
Yoav is a General Partner at Almaz Capital based in Silicon Valley. He spans over 25 years of venture capital, corporate development, and tech entrepreneurship.

 

Yoav joined Almaz after a tenure at Meta Platforms, where he led M&A and inorganic growth strategy development in several verticals. Earlier, Yoav was Managing Partner at StageOne Ventures, where he led early stage VC investments on the US-Israel bridge, focusing primarily on AI and cloud/SaaS software infrastructure. Notable exits from Yoav’s StageOne portfolio include Epsagon (acquired by Cisco), Apprente (acquired by McDonalds), and Apolicy (acquired by SysDig).

 

Prior to joining StageOne, Yoav was Vice President of Corporate Development at Cisco, where he engaged in over 20 company acquisitions totaling over $10 Billion, and managed an investment portfolio of close to $1 Billion, including over 40 direct minority investments, as well as hands-on LP positions with over 20 venture capital funds worldwide. Among others, while at Cisco Yoav helped ideate and create Almaz Capital’s first fund where Cisco was the defining anchor LP.

 

Before Cisco, Yoav helped establish Pitango Venture Capital’s Silicon Valley presence, and was involve with multiple investments including Clearforest (acquired by Reuters), RADLAN (acquired by Marvell), and Breach Security (acquired by Trustwave). Yoav had earlier operational experience as the founding Head of Engineering and General Manager at Colordesk, a software company in the imaging space, and in engineering leadership positions with Electronics for Imaging and other technology companies.

 

Yoav is a graduate of the Israeli Defence Force’s elite 8200 intelligence unit, where he was an officer in charge of numerous communications related advanced technology projects. Yoav holds an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business, as well as BS and MS in Computer Science from the Hebrew University.
